SHIPPED: Complete outfit decomposition + search pipeline in Docker
SIGNIFICANCE:
- Gemini identifies items with bounding boxes (e.g., {type:'polo', bbox:{y1:10,x1:20,y2:40,x2:80}})
- Sharp crops each item from the reference photo using bbox
- Playwright service uploads each crop to Vinted (bypasses DataDome with real Chromium)
- UUIDs batch-persisted to Postgres (race condition fixed)
- Search API fetches 5 from image UUID (CLIP visual search) + 20 from text cascade = 25 results
- Size filter applied to BOTH image search (size_ids param) and text search
- Results UI: 'Top Matches' section (coral border) above 'More Results' section
- UUIDs survive container restarts (stored in DB items JSON, not in-memory)
VERIFIED IN CHROME: Upload → items identified → wait ~50s for Playwright → Hunt → 24 finds with 5 Top Matches showing visually matched polos
